technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with trending ADX suggest capitulation, but absence of bullish reversals, negative CMF, bearish MACD, and price below all key moving averages indicate downtrend continuation risk outweighs bounce potential.

fundamental.summary: AOS shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 64 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear sentiment (22/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but stale congressional data (496+ days old) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (395.2) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 64 days adds moderate event risk; macro score of -1 confirms unfavourable conditions.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (9-period) combined with ADX trending and Supertrend bullish signal capitulation bounce potential in fear-driven market (22/100 sentiment).
debate.key_bear_argument: Price below all major moving averages, negative CMF distribution, bearish MACD, Ichimoku below cloud, zero bullish momentum confirmation, and VIX crisis regime (395.2) indicate downtrend continuation risk far outweighs bounce probability.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme RSI oversold and ADX trending suggest potential capitulation bounce; fear sentiment (22/100) offers contrarian opportunity. However, price below all major moving averages, negative CMF distribution, bearish MACD, and VIX crisis regime (395.2) create unacceptable downtrend continuation risk that outweighs bounce probability.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis environment (395.2) combined with price below all key moving averages and negative momentum confirmation creates high probability of continued downtrend despite oversold technicals.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already 3 positions in Industrials sector; adding AOS would increase sector concentration risk during unfavourable macro conditions without sufficient conviction to justify exposure.
